meta.note: The repo has no visual sources; tokens, fonts and logos are built from the concept art by tools/build_brand.py and tools/build_tokens.py.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. Every text token passes 7:1 on it.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised areas: cards, panels, code blocks. Every text token passes 7:1 on it.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Inset and hover fills, table header rows. Every text token passes 7:1 on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on any surface (11.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, captions. Still AAA: 7.3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and text actions; always underlined. 7.6:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Pair with on-action text.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an action fill (13.5:1 light, 9.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and other controls; 3.8:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines only. Never the only cue for a control's edge.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline with a 2px offset on every focusable element.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Valid / passed text and icons. Always paired with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution text and icons. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and destructive text and icons. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: The icon tile and the wordmark ink on light grounds. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: Start of the ring gradient (bottom-left). Decorative only: 3:1 on white, so never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: brand-mint
tokens.usage: End of the ring gradient (top-right). Decorative fills and highlights; never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: brand-cream
tokens.usage: The person glyph inside the mark (12.5:1 on brand-navy).

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", sans-serif
families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, "Noto Sans Mono", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page, hero only. Mobile size; step up to 3.5rem from 48rem wide.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: A schema for describing people and organisations consistently.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each profile is validated against the schema before it is saved.
styles.usage: Default running text. 1.6 line height meets WCAG 1.4.8 (AAA).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata and helper text. Smallest size allowed.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and code blocks, schema keys and values.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The product name as a graphic only (cover, splash). In products use the outlined wordmark SVG, not live text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding; list item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on small screens; page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding from 48rem; paragraph spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections from 48rem.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and large panels.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The app-icon tile corner (112 of 512). Use on any square that frames the mark.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and status badges.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target (WCAG 2.5.5, AAA).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for running text (WCAG 1.4.8 asks for 80 characters or fewer).

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus outline width and offset.
